name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (gfx/blit domain). Descriptor accurately reflects behavior: blits a 24x24 tile sprite to a pixel position in the battle preview/intro grid layout. '24x24' is the meaningful tile dimension, not address residue; the trailing 'position' is descriptive. No Ghidra address residue. Sole caller fd2_render_battle_scene_with_portrait_grid_layout @ 0x34010 places chapter-digit, player-row, enemy-row, and reserved-highlight tiles at grid positions via this helper, confirming the name.
purpose: 24x24 tile blit helper: resolve a tile sprite pointer from an atlas offset table, compute the destination pixel address from buffer/stride/x/y, and tail-call the plain passthrough blitter.
logic_summary: src = atlas_base + *(int*)(atlas_base + tile_index*4 + 6) (each atlas entry is 4 bytes; the 4-byte value at +6 from the entry is the sprite's absolute byte offset within the atlas). dst = dst_buffer + dst_y * dst_row_stride + dst_x. Then fd2_tile_blit_24x24_passthrough(src, dst, dst_row_stride). Compiler-injected __CHK(0x14) stack-probe prologue only; void return. Disassembly @ 0x3415e confirms: SHL EAX,2 (tile_index*4) + atlas_base -> entry; atlas_base + [entry+6] -> src (EDX); dst_y IMUL dst_row_stride + dst_buffer + dst_x -> dst (EAX); PUSH stride,dst,src; CALL 0x4deda.
signature: void fd2_blit_24x24_tile_to_battle_grid_position(uint32 atlas_base, uint32 tile_index, uint32 dst_buffer, uint32 dst_row_stride, uint32 dst_x, uint32 dst_y)

params.name: atlas_base
params.semantics: Tile atlas base address. Each tile entry is 4 bytes; the 4-byte value at +6 from the entry is the sprite's absolute byte offset within the atlas. Caller passes the character/digit tile atlas, or data_fd2_runtime_battle_state_ptr for the reserved-position highlight tile.
params.reason: Accurately names the atlas base pointer used for sprite-offset lookup; no address residue; matches caller usage.

params.name: tile_index
params.semantics: Index into the atlas (multiplied by 4 for the 4-byte entry stride). Caller passes a chapter digit (0x40 + digit), a player/enemy character id from a byte array, or 0 for the highlight tile.
params.reason: Accurately names the per-entry index; no address residue; matches caller usage.

params.name: dst_buffer
params.semantics: Destination framebuffer base linear address (the 64000-byte working canvas in the caller).
params.reason: Accurately names the destination buffer base; no address residue.

params.name: dst_row_stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride in bytes (caller always passes 0x140 = 320). Used both to compute dst (dst_y * stride) and forwarded to the passthrough blitter as the blit pitch.
params.reason: Accurately names the row stride; no address residue; matches both uses.

params.name: dst_x
params.semantics: Destination pixel x coordinate (column offset added to dst).
params.reason: Accurately names the x pixel coordinate; no address residue; matches caller grid-x values.

params.name: dst_y
params.semantics: Destination pixel y coordinate (row index multiplied by dst_row_stride for dst).
params.reason: Accurately names the y pixel coordinate; no address residue; matches caller grid-y values.

returns.semantics: No return value; performs the blit as a side effect.
